---
title: "Penguin Data Analysis"
format: html
---

# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Summary

```{r}
bill_summary <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    average_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm= TRUE)
  )
```

# Visualization

```{r}
ggplot(bill_summary, aes(x = species, y = average_bill_length, fill = species)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Penguin Bill Length by Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Average Bill Length (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
